items.prompt: Why can adding DISTINCT be a bad repair for inflated trade totals?

options.text: It always resolves every business-key conflict
options.why: Deduplication does not decide which conflicting record is valid.

options.text: It can hide duplicate keys or remove valid repeated events
options.why: Distinctness of selected values is not a source identity policy.

options.text: SQL forbids DISTINCT with all financial data
options.why: There is no such domain-specific prohibition.

options.text: It automatically reports every rejected source row
options.why: It does not produce a rejection ledger by itself.

items.explanation: Fix duplicate handling at the declared identity boundary. A presentation-level deduplication can conceal or change business events.
